decisions.reason: The perfect binder sits squarely within the firm's long-standing finishing expertise and service capabilities, so the firm can interpret results and refine the offer despite lacking in-house R&D.
The fully automatic perfect binder builds on established binding knowledge and fits the strategic push toward integrated automation, which favours retention.
The inline/nearline booklet maker is core to the firm's bookletmaking portfolio and its digital-print finishing direction, so the firm's related knowledge supports keeping it.
